_comment: Zombie visuals. avatars: Rocketbox GLBs built by fetch-assets (assets.manifest.json); walk/run = authored ground speeds (m/s) from the build log. archetypes: avatar indices each archetype draws from (by the zombie's `vary`). look: the zombie treatment of the avatars' materials (game-side TSL): `saturation`/`envIntensity` as the engine look; skin (detected by hue) is replaced by `skinTint` x luminance x `skinGain`; everything else is desaturated by `clothDesat`, darkened by `clothDarken` and mixed `grimeMix` toward `grime`. `shamble`: walk playback rate per m/s of ground speed relative to the clip's authored speed (slowed), clamped to [min, max].
